pages.text: There is five kinds of Basic Dusts: $(item)Metal Dust$(), $(item)Life Dust$(), $(item)Order Dust$(), $(item)Fire Dust$(), $(item)Earth Dust$(). $(br2)With $(item)Hand Vacuum$(), you will only be able to collect the Heavier Dust: $(item)Metal Dust, $(item)Order Dust$() and $(item)Earth Dust$().
To collect all kinds of Basic Dust, you need a $(item)Iron Vacuum$().
